Hey guys!
One question: in general terms, what is the difference between libbitcoin v2 and v3?

elements.text: another question, what is the recommended way to build libbitcoin?

text: another question, what is the recommended way to build libbitcoin?

elements.text: Recommended mechanism of building since they've been introduced are the install.sh scripts for macos/linux systems and msbuild of the solution files for Visual Studio.

text: Recommended mechanism of building since they've been introduced are the install.sh scripts for macos/linux systems and msbuild of the solution files for Visual Studio.

elements.text: As for differences between v2 and v3, v2 is old enough that I don't recall ever supporting it in Travis, let alone github actions CI systems.  I'm relatively sure there were protocol changes between v2 and v3 within the libbitcoin server protocol that were breaking, but I don't recall specifics without investigation.  The v2 codebase has only experienced README changes since 2016.
